title: What Income Spectrum Actually Is
hook: I built this because I couldn't find one place that had everything.
seo_keywords: income options for entrepreneurs, income path for beginners
script_line1: Someone wants to start earning on their own - contractor work, freelance, a side income - and they spend hours bouncing between random websites trying to piece it together.
script_line2: Income Spectrum is the free resource hub I wish had existed. One place where you can find actual income platforms - Fiverr, Angi Pro, Thumbtack, Clarity - plus certifications, business tools, and state-by-state government resources.
script_line3: It's not a course. It's not a membership. It's free. You go, you explore, you find what fits where you actually are right now.
script_line4: There's also a companion app with a quiz that helps you figure out what type of founder you are - and from there, what income paths actually make sense for you.
script_line5: If you've been trying to figure out how to start earning independently, this is worth ten minutes of your time.
overlay_1: Free resource hub - no membership required
cta: Go check it out at incomespectrum.com - no email required, no paywall, just go look around.

title: How to Use the App
hook: The app does something the website can't - it learns about you first.
seo_keywords: founder identity, income path for beginners
script_line1: The Income Spectrum app is at incomespectrum.app - and the main thing it does differently is the Founder Identity Quiz.
script_line2: You open the app, take the quiz - maybe five minutes - and it figures out what type of founder you are. Hands-on, service-based, digital, product-focused?
script_line3: Once you have that, you get what's called a Founder File - your result profile. From there the app points you toward income platforms, certifications, and resources that match how you work.
script_line4: There's also a state resource lookup. Pull up your state and get licensing requirements, programs, and what's specific to where you are.
script_line5: The app is mobile-friendly, free, and a good starting point if you don't know where to begin. Take the quiz first.
overlay_1: Founder Identity Quiz - free in the app
overlay_2: Your Founder File = your personalized starting point
cta: Download or open the app at incomespectrum.app and take the quiz - takes about five minutes.

title: What Makes Income Spectrum Different
hook: Most resources for entrepreneurs are either too broad or trying to sell you something.
seo_keywords: entrepreneur tools and resources, business platforms for independent workers
script_line1: There are a lot of websites that tell you 'here are ways to make money.' Usually surface-level, often affiliate-driven, and they don't help you figure out what fits you specifically.
script_line2: Income Spectrum is different in a few ways. It's actually organized - real sections: income platforms, education and training, supportive services, state and federal resources.
script_line3: The app has the Founder Identity Quiz, which helps you figure out what kind of entrepreneur you are before you start throwing yourself at platforms that might not be a good fit.
script_line4: The state pages are genuinely useful. Each state has its own page with licensing information, state-specific programs, and resources a lot of people don't even know exist.
script_line5: And none of it costs anything. There's no upsell. There's no course at the end. Just a well-organized, free resource hub.
overlay_1: Organized by category - not a random list

title: Everything You Can Find on Income Spectrum
hook: I'll give you a quick tour because it's more than most people realize.
seo_keywords: income options for entrepreneurs, entrepreneur tools and resources, side hustle platforms
script_line1: The main site has five sections. Income Options - platforms where you can start earning. Angi Pro, Fiverr, Thumbtack, Clarity, Catalant, Outschool, Care.com, FlexJobs, RealPage, MyVendorCenter.
script_line2: Education and Training - certifications for skilled trades and professional services. ALOA for locksmiths, AWS for welding, NACPB for bookkeeping.
script_line3: Supportive Services - business formation, compliance tools, things that help you run a business once you've started one.
script_line4: State and Federal Resources - every US state has its own page. Licensing info, state programs, federal programs.
script_line5: The app adds the Founder Identity Quiz and state-based lookup on mobile. All free. All organized.
overlay_1: 5 sections: Income / Education / Services / State Resources / Blog
cta: Go to incomespectrum.com and start with whatever section is most relevant to where you are right now.

title: Income Spectrum for Side Hustlers vs Full-Time Entrepreneurs
hook: It works for both - but you'll use it differently.
seo_keywords: side hustle platforms, income options for entrepreneurs, how to start earning independently
script_line1: If you're a side hustler - you have a job and you're trying to build something on the side - Income Spectrum is useful for finding platforms you can start using now. Fiverr, Thumbtack, Care.com, FlexJobs.
script_line2: The Education section is also worth looking at if you want a certification that makes you more hireable or lets you charge more for what you already do.
script_line3: If you're going full-time, the site has more depth. State pages have licensing and program info. Supportive Services has formation and compliance tools.
script_line4: The Founder Identity Quiz in the app helps you get clear on what type of business actually fits how you operate.
script_line5: Side hustlers use the income and education sections heavily. Full-time founders use everything - especially state resources and supportive services.

overlay_2: Use what's relevant to where you are now
